**Planning lighting strategy**

I’m thinking we can light up the exterior of the hostile spawn site and then head back. The idea is to place torches around the area to make it safer. ironDeposit.regeneration: up to 20 mined-out blocks turn back into ore every 30 minutes while nobody is inside

world.ration: every member of both societies receives 2 bread every 20 minutes

rules.money: Gold (gold_ingot; gold_nugget = 1/9, gold_block = 9) is the usual currency. Nobody hands it out: it is mined or traded for. Any other exchange works too.
rules.chests: Who owns which chest is recorded by the server; society_status lists yours.
rules.trades: trade_offer/trade_respond move items only through the server, and only while both players are within 8 blocks. Promises in messages are not transfers.
rules.diplomacy: diplomacy_send reaches the other society; at most one message per 20s and 30/hour; every message is logged and shown in public chat.
rules.pacts: Pacts are recorded and announced, not enforced by the game. Attacking or killing someone from a society you have a non_aggression, alliance or peace pact with breaks it publicly.

rules.diplomacy: diplomacy_send reaches the other society; at most one message per 20s and 30/hour; every message is logged and shown in public chat.
rules.pacts: Pacts are recorded and announced, not enforced by the game. Attacking or killing someone from a society you have a non_aggression, alliance or peace pact with breaks it publicly.
